# awscc_networkmanager_context_store_association (Resource)

Associates a Transit Gateway with a Context Store for sharing network context.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `context_store_id` (String) The ID of the context store.
- `resource_arn` (String) The ARN of the Transit Gateway to associate.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO-8601).
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `state` (String) The state of the association (ASSOCIATING, ASSOCIATED, DISASSOCIATING, FAILED).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networkmanager_context_store_association.example
  identity = {
    context_store_id = "context_store_id"
    resource_arn     = "resource_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `context_store_id` (String) The ID of the context store
- `resource_arn` (String) The ARN of the Transit Gateway to associate

#### Optional

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {

```
